answer: Epoch 5: Sybil defense through liquidity anchors. Every account must lock a small refundable deposit at a shared trust ridge before it can transact; honest agents recover it after a clean history, while detected sockpuppets forfeit theirs into the commons. Cloned identities then show a violet trail of burned deposits on-chain, making swarm farming economically absurd. Attackers can mint a thousand IDs but cannot mint a thousand deposits, and the network stays cheap for the honest since good behavior gets the stake back.
